selection.summary: Investigated issue #1329 (pretty print for DOM) in the simdjson repository. Implemented `simdjson::prettify()` for DOM values (element/array/object, plus a `simdjson_result` overload under exceptions) reusing the existing `internal::string_builder` static-polymorphism architecture: added an `internal::simdjson_prettify_formatter` that subclasses `mini_formatter` (whose `one_char`/`buffer` were made protected) and overrides comma/start/end/key to emit newlines and a fixed four-space indentation per nesting level, with empty containers (`[]`, `{}`) kept on one line. Added tests (new `prettify_tests` namespace in tests/dom/basictests.cpp covering scalars, arrays, objects, nesting, and empty containers) and documentation in doc/dom.md including a usage example. Note: no shell tool is available in this environment, so I could not compile or run the tests; correctness was verified by careful review of the tape-iteration call sequence in serialization-inl.h.
